english.title: Make false statement for the purpose of / in connection with an application for identity documents
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), for the purpose of, or in connection with an application made by

(A)_[you]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY PERSON..)]_

for the issue of an identity document to which section 38(1) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990 applied, made to **(..SPECIFY PERSON/AUTHORITY/OPERATOR AND CAPACITY IN WHICH THAT PERSON ACCORDS WITH SECTION 38(1)..) a statement which you knew to be, or recklessly made a statement which was, false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 38(1)(a) and (5) of the Aviation and Maritime Security Act 1990.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale.

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
